extracted.intended_audience: state & local government agencies; public engagement professionals; community outreach teams
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and feature set for evaluating/choosing a centralized community engagement platform for government use, emphasizing inclusivity, analytics, meetings, accessibility, and operational efficiency. Useful for procurement, product selection, or designing an engagement program supported by software.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Create equitable opportunities for input across every channel—email, text, surveys, meetings, and more. PublicInput makes it easy to meet people where they are, collect feedback in real time, and reach the full spectrum of your community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize no silos and no guesswork; platform should enable engagement that reflects your people and reach underrepresented groups (residents with limited English proficiency, people with disabilities, communities of color).

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-channel Participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Support across channels (email, text, surveys, meetings, phone) so residents can participate via the medium they prefer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include phone/voicemail integration and offline tools so participation isn't limited to online-only access; 'meet people where they are.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Built-in Analytics / Data That Empowers
rubrics_metrics.description: With built-in analytics, demographic comparisons, and sentiment tracking, the platform helps you understand who’s participating—and who’s not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use analytics to measure reach, demonstrate impact, and make decisions grounded in clear, representative data. Provides evidence to 'defend decisions' and avoid assumptions/backlash.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographic Comparisons / Representative Insights
rubrics_metrics.description: Capability to compare participation across demographic groups to reveal gaps in representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify who is not participating so outreach can be targeted; required for demonstrating equity and representativeness in decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentiment Tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Track the sentiment of comments and responses to gauge community attitudes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine sentiment with demographic data and participation metrics to produce actionable insights for decisions and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connected Teams and Clear Communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Unite departments and tools in one platform—making it simple to collaborate, share insights, and keep messaging consistent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid duplication and conflicting messaging; platform should enable coordinated outreach that builds public trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capture, Categorize, and Distill Feedback Automatically
rubrics_metrics.description: Every comment, question, and suggestion is captured, categorized, and distilled into clear, actionable insights—automatically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduces manual data compilation and guessing; supports faster, more confident reporting and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Features like live polling, Q&A, and in-meeting comment tracking to engage residents in the moment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports two-way conversation rather than delayed reaction; increases human connection and ongoing dialogue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smooth Public Meetings / Meeting Tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for in-person, online, or hybrid meetings including live streaming, registration, comment capture, moderation, and automatic transcripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform should reduce meeting logistics workarounds so staff can focus on listening and producing usable meeting records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility and Translation Features
rubrics_metrics.description: Built-in translation, offline tools, and accessibility features to ensure no one’s left behind.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential for including residents with limited English proficiency and those with disabilities; supports equitable participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Close the Loop / Traceability of Input to Decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Every comment, meeting, and survey response is automatically logged and connected, giving teams visibility and proof of how public voices shape real decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable reporting that shows exactly how input influenced outcomes—important for accountability and defending decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational Efficiency / Reduce Fragmentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Centralize projects and surveys in one place to avoid disjointed tools that waste time and cause siloed workflows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduce manual data aggregation, prevent project delays, and lower administrative burden; supports faster implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usable Public Feedback / Actionable Outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Feedback should be captured and distilled into clear, actionable insights so teams can lead with confidence and report with clarity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Output must be organized for decision-makers rather than requiring deep manual analysis or interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phone & Offline Participation Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide phone-based participation (voicemail lines, phone tab) and offline capture so non-digital users can contribute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures broader inclusion and that the platform 'has a voicemail line' or equivalent to minimize missed voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderation and Comment Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools for comment capture plus moderation workflows to manage public input during and after meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include automatic transcripts and moderation capabilities to maintain civility and usable records.

rubrics_metrics.name: One Hub for Resident Engagement / Project Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Create projects and surveys in one place—so you can inform residents, collect feedback, and make confident, inclusive decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centralized project hub prevents confusion and missed voices, enabling a single source of truth for engagement activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting, Visualization, and Case Evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools and case studies to 'defend decisions with complete data' and provide visuals/metrics for stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes dashboards, exportable evidence, and case studies to demonstrate impact to internal/external stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase Participation / Awareness & Outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Support engagement, awareness, and outreach workflows designed to boost resident participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use coordinated outreach and inclusive channels to drive higher turnout and reduce 'low participation' outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance and Risk Reduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduce regulatory and compliance challenges by maintaining comprehensive, auditable engagement records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centralized logs, transcripts, demographics, and analytics help meet legal/administrative requirements and defend policy choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer Support & Implementation Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Start with a consultation, receive a tailored demo and an implementation plan with timeline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vendor should offer onboarding support and personalized plans to achieve goals and integrate the platform into existing workflows.
